name: io.github.seigwen/dualtran-mcp
description: Translate text with Google or your own AI model (BYOK, 20+ providers) from any MCP client.

environmentVariables.name: DUALTRAN_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: AI provider id (openai, anthropic, google, deepseek, ...). Optional — Google works without a key.

environmentVariables.name: DUALTRAN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the selected AI provider (BYOK). Optional.

environmentVariables.name: DUALTRAN_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model id for the AI provider (e.g. gpt-4o-mini). Optional.
